title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched!
summary: We're excited to announce the full public release of Spyglass, delivering powerful new capabilities to enhance your productivity and insights.

title: Enhanced File Management in Your Editor
summary: Experience unparalleled control over your content with new tools to effortlessly manage, download, and visually customize how your files appear directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a new public roadmap so you can easily track our latest achievements, current priorities, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience with our revamped checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable to boost your productivity.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Experience a significantly smoother and more intuitive way to co-create with your team, making teamwork effortless and highly productive.

title: Seamless Sharing and Collaboration
summary: We've rolled out exciting improvements that make finding and collaborating on shared ideas and quests with your network more intuitive and effective.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with ultimate control, transparency, and the exciting opportunity to contribute directly to its evolution.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: This new update empowers users worldwide to fully experience Noeko in their native language, fostering greater inclusivity and reach.

title: Elevate Your Experience with New & Improved Themes
summary: Get ready for a visually stunning upgrade as we refine existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new styles to personalize your workspace.

title: Enhanced Constellation View for Deeper Discovery
summary: Discover connections and streamline your workflow like never before with powerful new filtering capabilities and integrated sharing features in the enhanced Constellation View.

title: Dynamic Search & Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information within your knowledge base by utilizing powerful new filters, flexible date ranges, and advanced sorting options, then save your refined searches as custom collections for instant retrieval.

title: Interactive Content Previews
summary: Experience new flexible and interactive ways to view and engage with your linked content, allowing you to seamlessly organize and navigate your ideas.

title: Noeko: Unleash Your Potential with Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Empower your workflow with Noeko's new self-hosting options and flexible premium plans, giving you complete control over your data and unlocking advanced capabilities.

title: Perfectly Timed Homepage Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the most accurate time-of-day message, providing a more precise and personalized experience.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Efficiently manage your content by performing essential actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, and viewing details directly within your tag lists, saving you clicks and time.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Access and analyze a wider array of content, from YouTube videos to websites and text files, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable insights in one central hub.
